summary: Nasdaq rose 2% on May 6 to 25,838.94; S&P 500 hit new record at 7,365.12. Gains driven by Iran peace deal hopes and strong tech/semiconductor earnings (AMD +17.77%, Supermicro +24.5%). Futures continued rising May 7 on Iran peace response expected. AI-led job cuts becoming a concern.
